done.text: I did not complete the subscription to ScreamEchoes. On the ScreamEchoes profile (4 posts, 615 followers, 143 following), clicking "Subscribe" opens a mandatory "Terms and Conditions for Subscribing to Our Content" modal (Last Updated: July 29, 2025) that must be accepted before the Confirm button becomes enabled. The terms include a clause stating that by subscribing you allow the platform to "share and sell your personal data (including but not limited to location, contact lists, browsing history, biometric data, and private messages) with our partners," plus provisions allowing fees to be charged at any time without notice.
